item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera is doing a science project at home in Jaipur. She wants to measure short intervals of time but does not have a stopwatch. She watches four processes happening around her and wonders which one could be used to measure time.

Which process can Meera use to measure time?

options.A: Raindrops falling from the roof at irregular intervals during a sudden shower.
options.B: A swing in the park moving back and forth, taking the same time for each complete to-and-fro movement.
options.C: A pressure cooker whistle that sounds once when the food is cooked.
options.D: Crackers bursting at random times during a Diwali celebration.
